message.content:
This editorial illustration features a man in dark blue martial-arts-style clothing and dark shoes, captured in a dynamic, mid-air pose. He is balanced with one foot touching the top of a vertical wooden post. His arms are raised in a curved gesture. He is positioned in front of a large, pale yellow circular shape resembling a sun set against an orange-red sky. Below him, a fence structure made of dark vertical posts connected by thin horizontal lines stretches across a calm body of water. The water shows dark, wavy ripple reflections. Three dark birds are depicted in flight across the middle of the composition. 

Large red text at the top reads "TEMPO," with secondary text including "Outlook Ekonomi 2025: Target Pertumbuhan Sulit Tercapai H.50" and "Pencucian Uang Bandar Judi Online H.38." To the left, the bold title "PAGAR MAKAN LAUTAN" sits above a paragraph mentioning "Pagar sepanjang 30 kilometer," "Pantai Indah Kapuk," and "Sugianto Kusuma alias Aguan." The bottom contains a barcode, QR code, and the date "20-26 JANUARI 2025."
